$comment: Read by ~/.claude/hooks/harness-gate.py. `staging`: finished work merges there; nothing but `release` reaches main (no PR, merge or push into main). `check_prs`: a PR into staging that changes any of `paths` needs a passing `command` verdict for the branch's HEAD tree in <main checkout>/.harness/verdicts/. A PR's check runs the browser audits its diff reaches; the release runs `command --full` on staging's combined tree. `check_prs` is overridden off for this repo by ~/.claude/hooks/harness-gate.json › skip_staging_pr_checks (since 2026-10-27).
cost: 1 to 4 minutes: every static check and the browser audits the branch's diff reaches; about a second for a docs-only commit after a pass
